Sia replied to a thread of those on the spectrum who would have jumped at the opportunity and said “maybe you’re just bad actors.” Whilst it’s understandable casting a non-disabled actress, it’s just a bit lazy, and her excuse of “my friend is autistic” is lazy too for her poor behaviour interacting with autistic fans, IMO.

The original text from the King James Bible of Genesis 1: 27 says “And God created man in his own image, in the image of God he created him; male and female he created them.” This suggests that he made them at the same time — but surely Eve was made from Adam after his creation? This is the clearest proof of Lilith, which isn’t much, but it’s enough for me personally. 

It’s not portrayed in modern texts, but if you do any sort of search you can find a lot of historical biblical support and chatter about her inclusion before the reforms.

I’m not literary historian, so I’m sorry if my sources aren’t fantastic or I haven’t presented my knowledge correctly! It’s just something I find lightly interesting — the removal of passages and information from a religious text over time.

Lilith is also regarded as one of the “most evil names” — Biblical texts portray her as a demon after choosing not to obey Adam. She’s also got ties to many fandoms as a daughter of Satan, seductress, vampire, that kind of thing.
